title: Chilli squid with cherry tomatoes
summary: Chilli squid with cherry tomatoes is a italian dinner built around squid rings and cherry tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat squid rings dry and season it. Prep cherry tomatoes and garlic for Chilli squid with cherry tomatoes so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook squid rings on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook cherry tomatoes and garlic in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Chilli squid with cherry tomatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice squid rings and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
